measure.$description: Maximum inline measure for a prose figure.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a figure follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a figure to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.

caption-spacing-before.$description: Block spacing between figure media and its caption.

caption-font-family.$description: Font family for prose figure captions.

caption-font-size.$description: Font size for prose figure captions.

caption-font-weight.$description: Font weight for prose figure captions.

caption-line-height.$description: Line height for prose figure captions.

caption-letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for prose figure captions.

caption-color.$description: Text color for prose figure captions.

caption-font-style.$description: Font style for prose figure captions.

caption-text-align.$description: Text alignment for prose figure captions.
